structure.unit: Uniform Adult Guardianship and Protective Proceedings Jurisdiction Act

law.catch_line: Relation to electronic signatures in global and national commerce act
law.text: This chapter modifies, limits, and supersedes the federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (15 U.S.C. § 7001 et seq.), but does not modify, limit, or supersede § 101(c) of that act (15 U.S.C. § 7001(c)) or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in § 103(b) of that act (15 U.S.C. § 7003(b)).
